{{Top|leg}}
'''Shave-and-a-haircut''' was a short rhythmic figure. In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] tapped the beginning of shave-and-a-haircut onto the deck plating covering the hidden floor compartments in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] narcotics officer [[Waywa Fybot]] was surreptitiously occupying at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. Fybot, recognizing the pattern, responded by tapping its final two beats, thus confirming he was inside the compartment.

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world "[[Wikipedia:Shave and a Haircut|Shave and a Haircut]]" is a seven-note musical couplet recognizable in popular culture, the rhythm of which is often used without its melody. In ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', it is purely rhythmic, with no melodic component.
